WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price,
    1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS size_per_length
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_length) AS avg_size_per_length
  FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
  a.AlbumId,
  a.avg_price,
  a.size_per_length,
  a.size_per_length - o.avg_size_per_length AS difference
FROM album_stats AS a
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
